title: GTA 6 Macca and Friends Trailer: Animated Show Revealed
description: The GTA 6 Macca and Friends trailer gives a first look at Rockstar's in-game animated series about a pink alligator in Leonida, per Polygon.

body.text: The GTA 6 Macca and Friends trailer is here, and it is the first time anyone has seen Rockstar's in-game animated series in action. According to Polygon, the teaser was posted by Discussing Film and shows a weird, adult-leaning cartoon that players will be able to watch inside the game. With launch set for Nov. 19, it is a small but telling look at how much side content Rockstar is packing into Leonida.
What the Macca and Friends trailer shows

The series centres on Macca, a pink alligator who wears sunglasses and lives in Leonida, which is Grand Theft Auto's take on Florida. Polygon says his circle includes Pinchie the crab, Chunkee the manatee, an unnamed flamingo and a human cop.
There is also a landlord, who is explicitly not a friend. The central plot point, per the teaser, is that Macca has to gather enough rent money to avoid being kicked out.
Polygon describes the tone as having big Adult Swim energy, and clearly aimed at an older audience. That fits the franchise, which has never been shy about satire and mature humour.
How will you watch it in GTA 6?

That is still unclear. The teaser does not explain how players will actually access the show. Polygon speculates that, given the level of immersion Rockstar is aiming for, it could be a full series with multiple episodes. That is the publication's guess, not something Rockstar has confirmed.
Polygon expects real answers only once the game is out.
If the teaser won you over, merch already exists. Rockstar is selling the Grand Theft Auto 6: The Good Time State — Vice City Collection for $399.99, according to Polygon.

body.text: Polygon reports that GTA 6 launches on Nov. 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. A Windows PC version has not been announced, which will matter to many Indian players who game on PC or in cafes.
Polygon also notes that Rockstar is already patching the game ahead of release day, a sign that the studio is still polishing right up to launch.

Keep an eye out for any word from Rockstar on how Macca & Friends works in-game, whether it is short clips or a proper multi-episode run. Also watch for any news on a PC version. For now, the trailer is a fun glimpse of the strange details waiting in Leonida, and the full picture should arrive when GTA 6 goes live on Nov. 19.

faqs.q: What is Macca & Friends in GTA 6?
faqs.a: Macca & Friends is an animated series that players will be able to watch inside GTA 6. According to Polygon, it follows a sunglasses-wearing pink alligator named Macca who lives in Leonida, the game's version of Florida.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 release date and which platforms are confirmed?
faqs.a: Polygon reports that GTA 6 releases on Nov. 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. A Windows PC version has not been announced.

faqs.q: How much is the GTA 6 Good Time State Vice City Collection?
faqs.a: Rockstar is selling it for $399.99, according to Polygon. It does not include a copy of GTA 6, but it comes with a Macca figure and a Chunkee shot glass, among other items.
